Jg.bar_b_note: Side B's saturated lightning-veined fur wolf holds the Tanglevolt bar beside a Palworld creature, though side A's faint frames lose the veins and float, and B's faint end tips nose-down onto its head.

Zd.bar_b_note: Warm sky, grass and half-timbered houses are close, but the flat road smear filling the foreground and the empty, unshafted daylight grade read as a prototype rather than Palworld/Valheim finish.

Br.bar_b_note: The Stormursa's furred, purple-veined naturalistic model at clear scale over the trainer carries it; only the crouched faint end is a soft read.

Uj.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder villager with clean face and eyes and a green/brown palette that fits the Meadows; the full-body view is small but coherent.

Ag.bar_b_note: A murky brown-green mid-tone forest with no purple storm sky, flat magenta outline telegraphs, a tiny unreadable player creature and HUD panels covering much of the frame sink it next to Palworld's bright boss fight.

Pn.bar_b_note: The fleece-and-horn Stormcapra holds in standing and hit react, but A's faint frames separate the horns from the head and B's faint mid floats horizontally above its shadow, breaking the finish.

Xz.bar_b_note: The purple storm sky and white-violet lightning in the break frame carry the mood, but a Meadows cottage on a flat empty plain, a uniform dark grass carpet and cartoon fog puffs in the fading frame sink it.

Bi.bar_b_note: Twisted trunks under a purple sky with rain and lightning read as Stormwood, but the pools are glowing-rimmed discs lying on the ground, the path carries flat painted gold crack lines, and the ground is a repeated grass block.

Rw.bar_b_note: The Stormursa model holds the bar on both sides, but side B's hit and faint poses barely change (faint end sits upright facing camera), so the faint does not read.

Ti.bar_b_note: The flower meadow approach and the hall's blue banners are appealing, but oversized flat white bricks, a foreground object cutting the camera and flat midday light without atmosphere keep it short of Palworld/Valheim finish.

top_changes.change: Replace the flat orange/olive village road and the repeated Stormwood grass carpet with a layered trodden-earth/moss/rock ground blend (pebbles, ruts, edge breakup) and group vegetation into edges and clearings.

Stormwood readability: set lantern pools into banked hollows with dark water, drop the flat gold crack decals and flat magenta telegraph outlines for real-object effects, pull the Ag fight camera out of the canopy, trim the HUD and lift the value range so both fighters read.
Fix the wolf, ram and bear (Rw B) faint animations so they collapse onto the ground with mesh and material intact: no floating, no detached horns, no nose-down tip-over, no lost lightning veins.
